sql: WITH a AS (SELECT 'access' t, rid, time_local, c_ip FROM access WHERE time_local LIKE '29/Sep/2026:%') SELECT t, count(DISTINCT rid) FILTER (WHERE regexp_extract(c_ip,'^(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\.',1) IN (SELECT net FROM n)) flood_req FROM a GROUP BY ALL

SELECT 'beta' t, substr(time_local,13,5) m, count(*) n FROM beta WHERE time_local LIKE '28/Sep/2026:%' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT domain, regexp_extract(cs_uri_query,'action=([A-Za-z_.]+)',1) akce, (cs_uri_query LIKE '%\%27%' ESCAPE '\' OR cs_uri_query LIKE '%\%2F\%2A%' ESCAPE '\' OR cs_uri_query LIKE '%library_version=%.&%' ESCAPE '\') payload, sc_status, sc_bytes, count(*) n FROM wdt WHERE time_local LIKE '28/Sep/2026:%' AND c_ip='89.163.154.141' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY akce, payload, sc_status

WITH b AS (SELECT c_ip FROM access_mp2
WHERE substr(time_local,4,8)='Sep/2026' AND substr(time_local,1,2) BETWEEN '16' AND '30'
AND cs_uri LIKE '/_/v1/elasticsearch%' GROUP BY c_ip HAVING count(DISTINCT cs_user_agent) >= 10),
r AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) c_ip, regexp_extract(domain,'([^ ]+)$',1) host,
strptime(substr(time_local,1,20),'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S') t_end, TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE) rt
FROM access_mp2 WHERE substr(time_local,4,8)='Sep/2026'
AND substr(time_local,1,2) BETWEEN '16' AND '30' AND cs_uri LIKE '/_/v1/elasticsearch%'
AND c_ip NOT IN (SELECT c_ip FROM b) AND NOT (c_ip LIKE '158.173.3.%'
OR c_ip LIKE '158.173.20.%' OR c_ip LIKE '158.173.21.%' OR c_ip LIKE '158.173.75.%'
OR c_ip LIKE '158.173.79.%' OR c_ip LIKE '212.56.48.%')),
e AS (SELECT c_ip, t_end - to_milliseconds(CAST(coalesce(rt,0)*1000 AS BIGINT)) ts, 1 d
FROM r UNION ALL SELECT c_ip, t_end, -1 FROM r),
c AS (SELECT c_ip, ts, sum(d) OVER (PARTITION BY c_ip ORDER BY ts, d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) conc FROM e),
s AS (SELECT c_ip, date_trunc('second', ts) sec, max(conc) mc FROM c GROUP BY c_ip, date_trunc('second', ts)),
rq AS (SELECT c_ip, count(*) reqs, arg_max(host,1) host FROM r GROUP BY c_ip)
SELECT s.c_ip, any_value(rq.host) host, any_value(rq.reqs) reqs, max(mc) max_conc,
quantile_disc(mc,0.99) p99_conc FROM s JOIN rq USING (c_ip) GROUP BY s.c_ip
ORDER BY max_conc DESC, reqs DESC LIMIT 15

WITH b AS (SELECT c_ip FROM access_mp2
WHERE substr(time_local,4,8)='Sep/2026' AND substr(time_local,1,2) BETWEEN '16' AND '30'
AND cs_uri LIKE '/_/v1/elasticsearch%' GROUP BY c_ip HAVING count(DISTINCT cs_user_agent) >= 10),
r AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) c_ip, regexp_extract(domain,'([^ ]+)$',1) host,
strptime(substr(time_local,1,20),'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S') t_end, TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE) rt
FROM access_mp2 WHERE substr(time_local,4,8)='Sep/2026'
AND substr(time_local,1,2) BETWEEN '16' AND '30' AND cs_uri LIKE '/_/v1/elasticsearch%'
AND c_ip NOT IN (SELECT c_ip FROM b) AND NOT (c_ip LIKE '158.173.3.%'
OR c_ip LIKE '158.173.20.%' OR c_ip LIKE '158.173.21.%' OR c_ip LIKE '158.173.75.%'
OR c_ip LIKE '158.173.79.%' OR c_ip LIKE '212.56.48.%')),
e AS (SELECT c_ip, t_end - to_milliseconds(CAST(coalesce(rt,0)*1000 AS BIGINT)) ts, 1 d
FROM r UNION ALL SELECT c_ip, t_end, -1 FROM r),
c AS (SELECT c_ip, ts, sum(d) OVER (PARTITION BY c_ip ORDER BY ts, d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) conc FROM e),
s AS (SELECT c_ip, date_trunc('second', ts) sec, max(conc) mc FROM c GROUP BY c_ip, date_trunc('second', ts)),
rq AS (SELECT c_ip, count(*) reqs, arg_max(host,1) host FROM r GROUP BY c_ip)
SELECT s.c_ip, any_value(rq.host) host, any_value(rq.reqs) reqs, max(mc) max_conc,
quantile_disc(mc,0.99) p99_conc FROM s JOIN rq USING (c_ip) GROUP BY s.c_ip
ORDER BY max_conc DESC, reqs DESC LIMIT 15

WITH ips AS (SELECT DISTINCT c_ip FROM access WHERE substr(time_local,1,11) IN ('04/Oct/2026','05/Oct/2026','06/Oct/2026','07/Oct/2026','08/Oct/2026') AND (cs_user_agent LIKE '%WP-Safe-Scanner%' OR cs_user_agent LIKE 'Hello from Palo Alto Networks%')) SELECT count(*) ips_celkem, count(il.label) ips_v_ip_labels, string_agg(DISTINCT il.label, ',') labels FROM ips LEFT JOIN ip_labels il ON TRY_CAST(ips.c_ip AS INET) <<= il.cidr::INET

WITH u AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) c_ip, sc_status, cs_method,
        regexp_extract(cs_uri,'^[^?]*') p, substr(cs_user_agent,1,60) ua, sc_bytes
    FROM access_mp2
    WHERE time_local LIKE '30/Sep/2026:19:%'
        AND substr(time_local,13,8) BETWEEN '19:29:20' AND '19:32:59'
        AND domain LIKE '%www.tos.cz'
)
SELECT 'ip' k, c_ip v, count(*) n,
    round(sum(TRY_CAST(sc_bytes AS BIGINT))/1e6,1) mb
FROM u GROUP BY 2 QUALIFY row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC)<=10
UNION ALL SELECT 'path', cs_method||' '||substr(p,1,60), count(*),
    round(sum(TRY_CAST(sc_bytes AS BIGINT))/1e6,1)
FROM u GROUP BY 2 QUALIFY row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC)<=10
UNION ALL SELECT 'status', sc_status, count(*),
    round(sum(TRY_CAST(sc_bytes AS BIGINT))/1e6,1) FROM u GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'ua', ua, count(*), NULL
FROM u GROUP BY 2 QUALIFY row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC)<=5
UNION ALL SELECT 'uniq_ip', CAST(count(DISTINCT c_ip) AS VARCHAR), count(*), NULL
FROM u ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

(SELECT 'serazene' typ, time_local, c_ip, sc_status, sc_bytes, http_referer, cs_uri FROM vvbox WHERE domain='d.vvbox.cz' AND cs_uri LIKE '/vv_show_url.php?idc=%' AND substr(time_local,1,11)='01/Oct/2026' USING SAMPLE 8 ROWS) UNION ALL (SELECT 'bezne', time_local, c_ip, sc_status, sc_bytes, http_referer, cs_uri FROM vvbox WHERE domain='d.vvbox.cz' AND cs_uri LIKE '/vv_show_url.php?idk=%' AND substr(time_local,1,11)='01/Oct/2026' USING SAMPLE 5 ROWS)

SELECT substr(time_local,1,11) den, count(*) radku, count(*) - count(DISTINCT (rid, time_local, c_ip, cs_uri)) dup_excess, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rid IS NULL OR rid IN ('', '-')) bez_rid FROM access WHERE substr(time_local,1,11) IN ('04/Oct/2026','05/Oct/2026','06/Oct/2026','07/Oct/2026') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT substr(time_local,13,2) hod, count(*) radku, count(*) - count(DISTINCT (rid, time_local, c_ip, cs_uri)) dup_excess FROM access WHERE time_local LIKE '07/Oct/2026:%' AND substr(time_local,13,2) IN ('03','04','05') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT strptime(substr(time_local,1,20),'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S') - INTERVAL (CAST(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE)*1000 AS BIGINT)) MILLISECOND st, domain, proxy_host, sc_status, TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE) rt, c_ip, split_part(cs_uri,'?',1) path FROM access_mp2 WHERE time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:06:%' AND substr(time_local,13,5) BETWEEN '06:40' AND '06:52') SELECT domain, proxy_host, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (sc_status='499') s499, count(*) FILTER (sc_status='504') s504, count(*) FILTER (sc_status LIKE '5%') s5xx, round(max(rt)) max_s, strftime(min(st),'%H:%M:%S') prvni_start, count(DISTINCT c_ip) ips FROM r WHERE rt>30 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT substr(time_local,1,11) den, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT c_ip) ips, count(*) FILTER (c_ip='185.138.46.95') ip95, round(sum(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE))) rt_sum FROM access_mp2 WHERE domain='www.zdraveorechy.cz' AND (time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:06:%' OR time_local LIKE '07/Oct/2026:06:%' OR time_local LIKE '06/Oct/2026:06:%') AND substr(time_local,13,5) BETWEEN '06:20' AND '06:44' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT substr(time_local,13,5) m, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (c_ip='185.138.46.95') ip95, round(sum(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (c_ip='185.138.46.95')) ip95_rt, count(DISTINCT c_ip) ips FROM access_mp2 WHERE domain='www.zdraveorechy.cz' AND time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:06:%' AND substr(time_local,13,5) BETWEEN '06:20' AND '06:52' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT split_part(cs_uri,'?',1) path, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (cs_uri LIKE '%?%') with_q, round(avg(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE)),2) avg_s, round(max(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE))) max_s, string_agg(DISTINCT sc_status,' ') st, substr(any_value(cs_uri),1,90) sample FROM access_mp2 WHERE c_ip='185.138.46.95' AND time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:06:%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT split_part(cs_uri,'?',1) path, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (cs_uri LIKE '%?%') with_q, round(avg(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE)),2) avg_s, round(max(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE))) max_s, string_agg(DISTINCT sc_status,' ') st, substr(any_value(cs_uri),1,90) priklad FROM access_mp2 WHERE c_ip='185.138.46.95' AND time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:06:%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12

WITH r AS (SELECT strptime(substr(time_local,1,20),'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S') - INTERVAL (CAST(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE)*1000 AS BIGINT)) MILLISECOND st, c_ip='185.138.46.95' ip95, sc_status, TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE) rt, regexp_replace(split_part(cs_uri,'?',1),'[0-9a-f]{24}','ID','g') ep FROM access_mp2 WHERE domain='www.zdraveorechy.cz' AND time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:06:%' AND substr(time_local,13,5) BETWEEN '06:38' AND '06:52') SELECT ep, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (ip95) n_ip95, round(sum(rt)) rt_sum, count(*) FILTER (rt>5) gt5, count(*) FILTER (rt>30) gt30, count(*) FILTER (sc_status='499') s499, strftime(min(st) FILTER (rt>5),'%H:%M:%S') prvni_slow FROM r WHERE st >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 06:38:00' AND st < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 06:47:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY rt_sum DESC LIMIT 12

WITH r AS (SELECT strptime(substr(time_local,1,20),'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S') - INTERVAL (CAST(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE)*1000 AS BIGINT)) MILLISECOND st, domain, c_ip, sc_status, TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE) rt, substr(cs_uri,1,60) uri, substr(cs_user_agent,1,30) ua FROM access_mp2 WHERE time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:06:%' AND substr(time_local,13,5) BETWEEN '06:38' AND '06:52') SELECT strftime(st,'%H:%M:%S') cas, domain, c_ip, sc_status, rt, uri, ua FROM r WHERE rt>20 AND st < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 06:45:30' ORDER BY st

WITH r AS (SELECT strptime(substr(time_local,1,20),'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S') - INTERVAL (CAST(TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE)*1000 AS BIGINT)) MILLISECOND st, cs_uri LIKE '/media/%' media, sc_status, TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE) rt FROM access_mp2 WHERE proxy_host='mp2a2' AND time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:06:%' AND substr(time_local,13,5) BETWEEN '06:36' AND '06:52') SELECT strftime(time_bucket(INTERVAL 30 SECOND, st),'%H:%M:%S') t30, count(*) FILTER (media) media_n, count(*) FILTER (media AND rt>5) media_gt5, round(max(rt) FILTER (media)) media_max, count(*) FILTER (NOT media) other_n, count(*) FILTER (NOT media AND rt>5 AND sc_status<>'499') other_gt5, round(max(rt) FILTER (NOT media AND sc_status<>'499')) other_max FROM r WHERE st >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 06:37:00' AND st < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 06:47:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT substr(time_local,13,5) m, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (sc_status='499') s499, count(*) FILTER (sc_status='503') s503, count(*) FILTER (sc_status='504') s504, count(*) FILTER (sc_status='502') s502, count(*) FILTER (TRY_CAST(request_time AS DOUBLE)>250) gt250 FROM access_mp2 WHERE proxy_host='mp2a2' AND time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:06:%' AND substr(time_local,13,5) BETWEEN '06:44' AND '06:52' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT column_name FROM (DESCRIBE access)

WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) rid, sid, c_ip, cs_user_agent FROM access WHERE substr(time_local,1,11) IN ('04/Oct/2026','05/Oct/2026','06/Oct/2026','07/Oct/2026','08/Oct/2026') AND isrobot='0' AND regexp_matches(cs_user_agent, '(?i)bot|crawl|spider|scan|fetch|python-requests|curl|wget|headless|http-client|preview')), top AS (SELECT cs_user_agent, count(*) reqs FROM u GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 30), uu AS (SELECT u.* FROM u JOIN top USING (cs_user_agent)), sc AS (SELECT sid, count(*) n FROM access WHERE substr(time_local,1,11) IN ('04/Oct/2026','05/Oct/2026','06/Oct/2026','07/Oct/2026','08/Oct/2026') AND sid != 'false' AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM uu) GROUP BY sid) SELECT count(*) reqs, count(DISTINCT uu.c_ip) ips, round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN sc.n>=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),2) pct_persist, substr(uu.cs_user_agent,1,180) ua FROM uu LEFT JOIN sc ON uu.sid=sc.sid GROUP BY uu.cs_user_agent ORDER BY reqs DESC

WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) rid, sid, c_ip, cs_user_agent FROM access WHERE substr(time_local,1,11) IN ('04/Oct/2026','05/Oct/2026','06/Oct/2026','07/Oct/2026','08/Oct/2026') AND isrobot='0' AND regexp_matches(cs_user_agent, '(?i)bot|crawl|spider') AND NOT regexp_matches(cs_user_agent, '(?i)bot/[0-9]|compatible;[^)]*bot|https?://[^ )]*bot')), top AS (SELECT cs_user_agent, count(*) reqs FROM u GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 20), uu AS (SELECT u.* FROM u JOIN top USING (cs_user_agent)), sc AS (SELECT sid, count(*) n FROM access WHERE substr(time_local,1,11) IN ('04/Oct/2026','05/Oct/2026','06/Oct/2026','07/Oct/2026','08/Oct/2026') AND sid != 'false' AND sid IN (SELECT sid FROM uu) GROUP BY sid) SELECT count(*) reqs, count(DISTINCT uu.c_ip) ips, round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN sc.n>=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),2) pct_persist, '`' || replace(substr(uu.cs_user_agent,1,220),'|','\|') || '`' ua FROM uu LEFT JOIN sc ON uu.sid=sc.sid GROUP BY uu.cs_user_agent ORDER BY reqs DESC

WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) rid, c_ip, cs_user_agent ua, regexp_extract(domain,'([^ ]+)$',1) host, split_part(cs_uri,'?',1) path FROM access WHERE substr(time_local,1,11) IN ('04/Oct/2026','05/Oct/2026','06/Oct/2026','07/Oct/2026','08/Oct/2026') AND regexp_matches(cs_user_agent, '(?i)^(python-requests|curl/|wget|python-urllib)')), p AS (SELECT c_ip, count(*) reqs FROM u GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=100), h AS (SELECT c_ip, host, count(*) n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c_ip ORDER BY count(*) DESC) r FROM u WHERE c_ip IN (SELECT c_ip FROM p) GROUP BY 1,2), pa AS (SELECT c_ip, path, count(*) n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c_ip ORDER BY count(*) DESC) r FROM u WHERE c_ip IN (SELECT c_ip FROM p) GROUP BY 1,2), ua AS (SELECT c_ip, string_agg(DISTINCT substr(ua,1,25), ', ') uas FROM u WHERE c_ip IN (SELECT c_ip FROM p) GROUP BY 1) SELECT p.c_ip, p.reqs, ua.uas, (SELECT string_agg(host||' ('||n||')', ', ' ORDER BY n DESC) FROM h WHERE h.c_ip=p.c_ip AND r<=3) hosty, (SELECT string_agg(substr(path,1,50)||' ('||n||')', ', ' ORDER BY n DESC) FROM pa WHERE pa.c_ip=p.c_ip AND r<=3) cesty, coalesce((SELECT string_agg(label, ',') FROM ip_labels il WHERE TRY_CAST(p.c_ip AS INET) <<= il.cidr::INET),'-') label FROM p JOIN ua USING (c_ip) ORDER BY p.reqs DESC

WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) rid, c_ip, cs_user_agent ua, regexp_extract(domain,'([^ ]+)$',1) host, split_part(cs_uri,'?',1) path FROM access WHERE substr(time_local,1,11) IN ('04/Oct/2026','05/Oct/2026','06/Oct/2026','07/Oct/2026','08/Oct/2026') AND regexp_matches(cs_user_agent, '(?i)^(python-requests|curl/|wget|python-urllib)')), p AS (SELECT c_ip, count(*) reqs FROM u GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=100), h AS (SELECT c_ip, host, count(*) n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c_ip ORDER BY count(*) DESC) r FROM u WHERE c_ip IN (SELECT c_ip FROM p) GROUP BY 1,2), pa AS (SELECT c_ip, path, count(*) n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c_ip ORDER BY count(*) DESC) r FROM u WHERE c_ip IN (SELECT c_ip FROM p) GROUP BY 1,2), ua AS (SELECT c_ip, string_agg(DISTINCT substr(ua,1,25), ', ') uas FROM u WHERE c_ip IN (SELECT c_ip FROM p) GROUP BY 1) SELECT p.c_ip, p.reqs, ua.uas, (SELECT string_agg(host||' ('||n||')', ', ' ORDER BY n DESC) FROM h WHERE h.c_ip=p.c_ip AND r<=3) hosty, (SELECT string_agg(substr(path,1,50)||' ('||n||')', ', ' ORDER BY n DESC) FROM pa WHERE pa.c_ip=p.c_ip AND r<=3) cesty, coalesce((SELECT string_agg(il.label, ',') FROM ip_labels il WHERE TRY_CAST(p.c_ip AS INET) <<= il.cidr::INET),'-') ip_label FROM p JOIN ua USING (c_ip) ORDER BY p.reqs DESC

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM alts) n_alts, (SELECT count(DISTINCT ua) FROM m) n_ua, (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE ua IN (SELECT ua FROM m)) reqs_match, (SELECT count(DISTINCT c_ip) FROM r WHERE ua IN (SELECT ua FROM m)) ips_match, (SELECT count(*) FROM ua_stat) n_ua_all

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM alts) n_alts, (SELECT count(DISTINCT ua) FROM m) n_ua, (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE ua IN (SELECT ua FROM m)) reqs_match, (SELECT count(DISTINCT c_ip) FROM r WHERE ua IN (SELECT ua FROM m)) ips_match, (SELECT count(*) FROM ua_stat) n_ua_all

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM alts) n_alts, (SELECT count(DISTINCT ua) FROM m) n_ua, (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE ua IN (SELECT ua FROM m)) reqs_match, (SELECT count(DISTINCT c_ip) FROM r WHERE ua IN (SELECT ua FROM m)) ips_match, (SELECT count(*) FROM ua_stat) n_ua_all

CREATE TABLE alts AS SELECT * FROM read_csv('tmp/isrobot-broad/alts.csv', header=true, quote='"', all_varchar=true); CREATE TABLE m AS SELECT s.ua, CAST(a.alt_id AS INT) alt_id, a.alt FROM ua_stat s JOIN alts a ON regexp_matches(CASE WHEN a.alt_id = '1' THEN regexp_replace(s.ua,'(?i)cubot','','g') ELSE s.ua END, '(?i)' || a.re); SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM alts) n_alts, (SELECT count(DISTINCT ua) FROM m) n_ua, (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE ua IN (SELECT ua FROM m)) reqs_match, (SELECT count(DISTINCT c_ip) FROM r WHERE ua IN (SELECT ua FROM m)) ips_match, (SELECT count(*) FROM ua_stat) n_ua_all

WITH x AS (SELECT m.alt_id, s.ua, s.reqs, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m.alt_id ORDER BY s.reqs DESC) rn FROM m JOIN ua_stat s USING (ua)), ri AS (SELECT m.alt_id, count(*) reqs, count(DISTINCT r.c_ip) ips FROM m JOIN r USING (ua) GROUP BY 1) SELECT CAST(a.alt_id AS INT) id, '`' || replace(a.alt,'|','\|') || '`' alt, coalesce(ri.reqs,0) reqs, coalesce(ri.ips,0) ips, (SELECT string_agg('`' || replace(substr(ua,1,70),'|','/') || '` (' || reqs || ')', ' ; ' ORDER BY reqs DESC) FROM x WHERE x.alt_id = CAST(a.alt_id AS INT) AND rn <= 3) top3 FROM alts a LEFT JOIN ri ON ri.alt_id = CAST(a.alt_id AS INT) ORDER BY 1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rules AS SELECT * FROM read_csv('tmp/isrobot-final/rules.tsv', delim='\t', header=true, quote='', all_varchar=true); CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE hits AS SELECT s.ua, CAST(ru.ord AS INT) ord, ru.kind, ru.val, ru.line FROM ua_stat s JOIN rules ru ON (ru.kind='exact' AND s.ua = coalesce(ru.pat,'')) OR (ru.kind='re' AND regexp_matches(CASE WHEN ru.ord='113' THEN regexp_replace(s.ua,'(?i)cubot|camscan','','g') ELSE s.ua END, CASE WHEN ru.ci='1' THEN '(?i)' ELSE '' END || ru.pat)); CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE res AS SELECT s.ua, s.reqs, s.ips, coalesce(f.val,'0') val, f.line FROM ua_stat s LEFT JOIN (SELECT ua, arg_min(val, (CASE WHEN kind='exact' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ord)) val, arg_min(line, (CASE WHEN kind='exact' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ord)) line FROM hits GROUP BY ua) f USING (ua); SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM rules) n_rules, (SELECT count(*) FROM rules WHERE kind='exact') n_exact, (SELECT count(*) FROM res) n_ua

SELECT c_ip, domain, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (regexp_matches(cs_uri_query,'%27[A-Za-z]{6}%3C%27%22%3E%29')) burp_marker, count(*) FILTER (sc_status LIKE '5%') s5xx, min(substr(time_local,13,8)) prvni, max(substr(time_local,13,8)) posledni, count(DISTINCT substr(time_local,1,11)) dni FROM wdt WHERE ((time_local LIKE '08/Oct/2026:%' AND substr(time_local,13,8) >= '06:16:00') OR (time_local LIKE '09/Oct/2026:%' AND substr(time_local,13,8) <= '06:16:00')) AND (c_ip IN ('193.34.214.13','10.201.33.102') OR regexp_matches(cs_uri_query,'%27[A-Za-z]{6}%3C%27%22%3E%29')) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) c_ip, sc_status, cs_user_agent, http_referer FROM access WHERE domain LIKE '%edit.magnetpro.cz' AND ((time_local LIKE '09/Oct/2026:%' AND substr(time_local,13,8) >= '12:00:00') OR (time_local LIKE '10/Oct/2026:%' AND substr(time_local,13,8) < '12:00:00')) AND cs_uri LIKE '/crmostra/%report_navstevy_show.php%') SELECT c_ip, sc_status, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT cs_user_agent) ua_n, min(substr(cs_user_agent,1,60)) ua, count(*) FILTER (http_referer<>'-') s_ref FROM u GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) c_ip, sc_status, cs_uri, cs_user_agent, http_referer FROM access WHERE domain LIKE '%kili.cz' AND ((time_local LIKE '09/Oct/2026:%' AND substr(time_local,13,8) >= '12:00:00') OR (time_local LIKE '10/Oct/2026:%' AND substr(time_local,13,8) < '12:00:00')) AND regexp_matches(cs_uri, '%D[01]%[89AB]|%E3%[81-83]|%E[4-9]%[89AB]', 'i')) SELECT regexp_extract(cs_uri,'^(/[^/?]*)',1) path, sc_status, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT c_ip) ips, count(DISTINCT cs_user_agent) uas, count(*) FILTER (http_referer<>'-') s_ref FROM u GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY n DESC

WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (rid) cs_uri FROM access WHERE domain LIKE '%edit.magnetpro.cz' AND ((time_local LIKE '09/Oct/2026:%' AND substr(time_local,13,8) >= '12:00:00') OR (time_local LIKE '10/Oct/2026:%' AND substr(time_local,13,8) < '12:00:00')) AND cs_uri LIKE '/crmostra/%report_navstevy_show.php%'), p AS (SELECT unnest(str_split(regexp_extract(cs_uri,'\?(.*)$',1),'&')) kv, length(cs_uri) len FROM u) SELECT split_part(kv,'=',1) param, CASE WHEN split_part(kv,'=',1)='PHPSESSID' THEN regexp_replace(split_part(kv,'=',2),'[a-z0-9]','x','g') ELSE split_part(kv,'=',2) END hodnota, count(*) n, max(len) max_uri_len FROM p GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
